answer.answer: Durable owner-readiness correction written and checkpointed. The earlier green assessment is superseded by a not-ready conclusion based on production-sized timeout, transaction-coupling, and write-amplification findings.

claims.value: Owner-readiness correction: Projects/Straylight current status.md, updated 2026-07-26T12:00:00-07:00, supersedes the earlier stale checkpoint. At about 64,000 active records and 9.6 million estimated source tokens, connection, authentication, and exact-path reads work, but broad memory.open and lexical retrieval can hit the 30-second database timeout. Because retrieval lanes share one transaction, a later lane failure can discard an earlier successful lane. Normal writes copy a full corpus membership manifest. Consequently, the current architecture is not ready for dependable owner use at 10x corpus growth. The approved—but not yet verified as implemented—direction is to make current Markdown files workspace truth, version only changed files, make indexes and derived views rebuildable, checkpoint with exact path/version/hash references plus changes since a workspace generation, and retain coherent source hydration with compact retrieval packets.

checkpoint.objective: Replace the earlier green owner-readiness checkpoint with a durable correction reflecting production-sized timeout and write-amplification findings.
current_state: The authoritative correction is Projects/Straylight current status.md, updated 2026-07-26T12:00:00-07:00.
The earlier green checkpoint is superseded.
Current owner corpus size is about 64,000 active records and 9.6 million estimated source tokens.
Broad memory.open and lexical retrieval can hit the 30-second database timeout.
Shared-transaction retrieval can lose an earlier successful lane when a later lane fails.
Normal writes copy a full corpus membership manifest.
The current architecture is not ready for dependable owner use at 10x corpus growth.
decisions: Adopt a not-ready owner-readiness conclusion.
Treat the approved architectural direction as proposed work, not completed implementation.
open_questions: Available evidence provides no finer-grained latency samples or exact manifest row/byte amplification measurement beyond full-corpus copying.
next_actions: Implement changed-file-only versioning and rebuildable indexes and derived views.
Isolate retrieval lanes so later failures cannot erase earlier successes.
Benchmark broad memory.open, lexical retrieval, failure recovery, and write amplification at current and 10x corpus scale before restoring green status.
